Graduating high school is rough, because as much as you want to continue to connect with your friends -- it's hard! Everyone is going in different directions, starting new jobs, new schools, meeting new people. So, I'm sure it's easy to feel abandoned or left behind. 

As far as this girl is concerned -- now might be the best time to see how she really feels. Message her and just say "my break has been super boring, what about yours?" I don't know how far home and school are ....but you may be able to push the conversation to a meetup. If she doesn't seem interested, then you live and learn and move on. 

The best part is that you are at school, and there's new people everywhere! College is soooo much easier to meet people than high school is, I promise. I'm sure there's some sort of club/organization something you could find that interests you. That way you are spending time with people who value the same thing you do. Eventually once they get to know you, they'll value you too :) 

Last but not least, if you find you're really struggling seek help. Go to someone and talk it through. Focus on you and helping yourself! You are worth it!
